# rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy (Data Source)

The `rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy` data source lists the subscriptions and management groups under an Azure
management group, and whether each subscription is eligible for onboarding through the management group. Use it to
compute the `subscription_ids` of the `rubrik_azure_management_group` resource.

RSC signs in as the customer app registered with the `rubrik_azure_service_principal` resource. The app's service
principal must have the `Contributor` and `User Access Administrator` roles at the management group scope.

~> **Note:** Once subscriptions have been onboarded, they are no longer eligible. Use `all_subscription_ids` rather
than `eligible_subscription_ids` for the `subscription_ids` of the `rubrik_azure_management_group` resource, otherwise
the next plan removes the onboarded subscriptions.

~> **Note:** The RSC feature flag `AZURE_CLOUDACCOUNTS_MANAGEMENT_GROUP_ENABLED` must be enabled for the RSC account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the subscriptions under a management group and their eligibility.
data "rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy" "prod" {
  tenant_domain       = "mydomain.onmicrosoft.com"
  app_id              = "25c2b42a-c76b-11eb-9767-6ff6b5b7e72b"
  management_group_id = "prod-mg"
  features            = ["CLOUD_NATIVE_PROTECTION"]
}

output "eligible_subscriptions" {
  value = data.rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy.prod.eligible_subscription_ids
}

# Limit the hierarchy to the immediate children of the management group.
data "rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy" "children" {
  tenant_domain       = "mydomain.onmicrosoft.com"
  app_id              = "25c2b42a-c76b-11eb-9767-6ff6b5b7e72b"
  management_group_id = "prod-mg"
  recurse             = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Azure app registration application ID (UUID) of the customer app.
- `management_group_id` (String) Azure management group ID.
- `tenant_domain` (String) Azure tenant primary domain.

### Optional

- `features` (Set of String) RSC features to check the eligibility of the subscriptions for.
- `recurse` (Boolean) Include the child management groups recursively. When `false`, only the immediate children are included. Default value is `true`.
- `scoped_management_group_ids` (Set of String) Child management group IDs to limit the hierarchy to. They must be descendants of `management_group_id`.

### Read-Only

- `all_subscription_ids` (Set of String) Azure IDs of all subscriptions in the hierarchy, eligible or not.
- `eligible_subscription_ids` (Set of String) Azure IDs of the subscriptions in the hierarchy that are eligible for onboarding.
- `id` (String) Data source ID, in the format `<tenant_domain>/<management_group_id>`.
- `management_groups` (Attributes List) Management groups in the hierarchy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management_groups))
- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) Subscriptions in the hierarchy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--management_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management_groups`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Azure management group display name.
- `native_id` (String) Azure management group ID.


<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `eligible` (Boolean) Whether the subscription can be onboarded through the management group.
- `ineligibility_reason` (String) Why the subscription cannot be onboarded, or `AZURE_ONBOARDING_INELIGIBILITY_REASON_UNSPECIFIED` when it is eligible.
- `name` (String) Azure subscription name.
- `native_id` (String) Azure subscription ID (UUID).
